recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: 93% turkey browned with onion and pepper, then black beans, salsa, and cumin. Rice pouch and avocado on the side.
steps: Dice onion and bell pepper. Drain the beans. Slice avocado.
Medium-high skillet, a little oil. Brown turkey with onion and pepper, breaking it up, 8–10 min until no pink.
Stir in drained beans, chili powder, cumin, a pinch of salt, and salsa. Simmer 3 min.
Heat rice pouch. Two plates: skillet over rice, avocado, cilantro, lime.

recipes.title: One-pot chicken tomato pasta
recipes.summary: Bite-size chicken with garlic, crushed tomato, spinach, and whole-wheat pasta in one pot. Parmesan to finish.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Medium-high pot, a little oil, salt, pepper. Sear until just cooked through (165°F), 5–6 min. Pull to a plate.
Same pot: garlic 30 sec. Add crushed tomatoes, 1½ cups water, pasta, a pinch of salt. Simmer uncovered, stirring, until pasta is al dente, 10–12 min. Splash water if it sticks.
Fold chicken and spinach in for 2 min until spinach wilts. Finish with Parmesan and basil.

recipes.title: Garlic-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: EZ-peel shrimp with broccoli, pepper, soy, and ginger over jasmine rice.
steps: Peel shrimp if needed and pat dry. Cut broccoli into florets and pepper into strips. Mince garlic and ginger. Start the rice pouch.
Hottest skillet, a little oil. Broccoli and pepper 3–4 min until crisp-tender; push aside.
Garlic and ginger 20 sec. Shrimp in a single layer 1–2 min per side until just opaque.
Splash soy. Toss. Scatter green onion on top. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan lemon salmon and potatoes
recipes.summary: Atlantic salmon roasted with potatoes and green beans, lemon finish.

ingredients.name: 1½ lb small red or gold potatoes

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast 12 min.
Oil, salt, and pepper the salmon. Add salmon and green beans to the sheet. Roast 10–12 min more until salmon flakes (145°F) and potatoes are tender.
